accepted_findings.decision: Use Apple's system trust store instead of certificate pinning.
accepted_findings.rationale: Pensieve talks to user-selected AI providers. Pinning provider certificates would break endpoint choice and certificate rotation while adding no stable trust boundary for this product.

accepted_findings.decision: Canonical metadata is not an executable subresource.
accepted_findings.rationale: The canonical link declares the preferred document URL and neither fetches nor executes third-party content, so subresource integrity does not apply.

accepted_findings.decision: Store the provider API key in the file-based login keychain without SecAccessControl user-auth gating.
accepted_findings.rationale: SecAccessControl(.biometryCurrentSet) routes the item to the macOS data-protection keychain, which requires provisioning-profile-backed keychain entitlements the Developer ID release signature does not carry; every save failed with errSecMissingEntitlement (-34018), blocking cloud autocomplete, and biometry gating excluded Macs without Touch ID. Silent access to the login-keychain item remains bound to the app's code signature.
